question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY2026 guidance is $197-202B (9-12% YoY growth, about 80bp FX headwind), lower than Q2's 20% mainly because Prime Day moved into June. Over the last 8 quarters Amazon landed between -0.7B and +3.7B of the top of guidance, with a median of about +0.5-1.6B (Q1'26 +3.0B, Q2'26 +1.6B). Consensus is about $202.1B, with one source citing about $205.7B. The dollar strengthened in late September (DXY up 2.4% after the Fed hike), a modest extra FX drag; AWS acceleration (37%) is a modest tailwind. The harness found no market on Polymarket or Manifold; I did not separately search Kalshi or bookmakers this run. Median about $202.6B.

calls.reconciliation: Factual FX dispute: Run 1 cited a late-Sept DXY rise of 2.4%; Run 3 said DXY was +0.35% for the quarter. These are compatible (a late rally on a flat quarter); YoY vs Q3 2025 (~98 DXY) gives a headwind about equal to the 80bp guide assumption, so FX is treated as roughly neutral vs guidance, slight downside tilt. Consensus dispute ($202.1B vs $205.65B) could not be verified with no web access; I weight the multi-source $202.1B more heavily. The judgment over how much to weight recent large beats (AWS acceleration) vs the longer median puts the median ~1B over the guide top.
